rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 6 independent sites (HCP Young Adult, HCP Development, UK Biobank, AOMIC PIOP2, Duke Neurogenetics Study, MIND-Set), each with different scanners (Siemens Skyra, Siemens Prisma, Philips Achieva dStream, GE MR750, Siemens Magnetom Prisma)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "We collated a large reference sample from 6 independent sites for whom high quality fMRI data for the EFMT are available: AOMIC PIOP2, Duke Neurogenetics Study, HCP Development, HCP Young Adult (1200 release), UK Biobank, and the MIND-Set cohort which also includes a clinical population."

rci2_using_epd.detail: HCP Young Adult, HCP Development, and UK Biobank are EPDs used in the reference cohort; AOMIC PIOP2, Duke Neurogenetics Study, and MIND-Set are non-EPD datasets
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "we take advantage of these large open-access/shared datasets to collate a large representative sample of over 7500 participants from six sites"
rci2_using_epd.location: Savage2024.pdf.md: Introduction, L35; Methods / Data sets, L211

rci3_epd_name.detail: HCP Young Adult (N=1044) and HCP Development (N=201) both fall under the HCP umbrella; UK Biobank (N=5000)
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "AOMIC PIOP2, Duke Neurogenetics Study, HCP Development, HCP Young Adult (1200 release), UK Biobank, and the MIND-Set cohort"
rci3_epd_name.location: Savage2024.pdf.md: Methods / Data sets, L211; Table 1, L137-L158

rci5_n.detail: Overall reference cohort N=7728 (HCP YA: 1044, HCP Dev: 201, UK Biobank: 5000, AOMIC PIOP2: 200, DNS: 1246, MIND-Set reference: 37). Training splits: faces>shapes train=3885, test=3843; faces>baseline train=3778, test=3950
rci5_n.supporting_text: "we estimated normative models of EFMT-related BOLD activation for the face>shapes and faces>baseline contrast using data from 7728 individuals across the lifespan. To achieve this, we split the data into training and test splits, stratified by site (face>shapes -train: 3885, test: 3843; faces>baseline -train: 3778, test: 3950)"
rci5_n.location: Savage2024.pdf.md: Results / Fitting reference normative models, L45; Table 1, L137-L158

rci6_sex.detail: Overall reference cohort; both models share the same 7728-subject reference cohort. Female counts summed from per-site data: HCP YA 561 + HCP Dev 110 + UKB 2495 + AOMIC 114 + DNS 707 + MIND-Set ref 21 = 4008. Male N derived by subtraction (7728 - 4008 = 3720)

rci7_age.detail: Overall reference cohort; both models share the same 7728-subject reference cohort. Weighted mean and combined SD computed from 6 sites: HCP YA (28.76±3.70, N=1044), HCP Dev (13.86±3.83, N=201), UKB (63.94±7.45, N=5000), AOMIC (22.16±1.79, N=200), DNS (20.22±1.21, N=1246), MIND-Set ref (38.0±16.11, N=37). Combined SD accounts for both within-site and between-site variance. Age in years
